lines: -[iOS] Make attaching a `JavaScriptNativeState` thread-safe, so JS objects of several runtimes can share one native state.

+[iOS] Make attaching a `JavaScriptNativeState` thread-safe, so JS objects of several runtimes can share one native state. Add `JavaScriptObject.setNativeStateIfAlive(_:)`, which attaches a native state only while another JS object holds it.

-[iOS] Support shared objects in worklets. A worklet can capture a shared object, whose JS objects in all runtimes share one native state, and which is kept until none of them is referenced. Event listeners are supported only in the main runtime.

+[iOS] Support shared objects in worklets. A worklet can capture a shared object, whose JS objects in all runtimes share one native state, and which is kept until none of them is referenced. `release()` in any runtime releases it in all of them. Event listeners are supported only in the main runtime.
